criteria.description: Every fixture renders the fixed div.sk-progress > label.sk-progress__label[for] + progress.sk-progress__bar[id][value][max] + span.sk-progress__meta structure, with no element added, removed, or reordered.
criteria.evidence: apps/storybook/src/tests/sk-progress.spec.ts — ordered native label/progress/meta structure passed in 24 Chromium+Firefox focused tests and 12 WebKit focused tests
criteria.notes: Verified by WP01 T007's DOM-structure assertion over every generated fixture (host direct children in order, per-child tag/attribute check).

criteria.description: No CSS content/counter() expression or JavaScript derives value, max, label, or meta text from anything other than the consumer's own authored attributes/text.
criteria.evidence: apps/storybook/src/tests/sk-progress.spec.ts — source arithmetic/content absence assertion passed across Chromium, Firefox, and WebKit
criteria.notes: Verified by WP01 T007's static-source assertion reading sk-progress.css for a content declaration referencing value/max/counter( (negative-property pattern, mirroring sk-transition-matrix.spec.ts:495).

criteria.description: The label is associated to the control by a plain light-DOM for/id pair, with zero aria-label, aria-labelledby, or role attributes anywhere in the fixture set.
criteria.evidence: apps/storybook/src/tests/sk-progress.spec.ts — native for/id association and zero authored aria/role attributes passed across three engines
criteria.notes: Verified by WP01 T007's accessible-name assertion plus a zero-match grep for aria-/role= across every fixture.

criteria.description: The control's accessible role, and its aria-valuenow/aria-valuemin/aria-valuemax, derive entirely from the browser's native <progress> semantics and the element's own value/max attributes.
criteria.evidence: apps/storybook/src/tests/sk-progress.spec.ts — native progressbar role/name/value/min/max accessibility-tree assertion passed across three engines
criteria.notes: Verified by WP01 T007's accessibility-tree snapshot assertion on the T10 fixture (role/name/value/min/max against label text and progress attributes).

criteria.description: The <progress> fallback text and the sk-progress__meta span are two separately authored strings in every fixture; neither is generated from the other.
criteria.evidence: packages/styles/src/progress/*.html and kitty-specs/work-package-native-progress-styles-01M1VKQ8/reviews/wp-WP01-cycle2.yaml — fallback and meta strings independently authored
criteria.notes: Authoring discipline confirmed by reading WP01 T001's fixtures (both strings present, hand-authored). The numeric-consistency dimension between them is separately, automatically verified under NFR-004 by T007.

criteria.description: Authored fixtures exist for every required determinate state: zero, T10 5-of-8, complete, a large total, and a long label.
criteria.evidence: packages/styles/src/progress/ and generated packages/styles/src/progress/index.ts — zero, 5-of-8, complete, large-total, and long-label fixtures reviewed
criteria.notes: Confirmed by WP01 T001's five state fixtures existing on disk and appearing in the generated barrel (build-styles-only-markup.mjs --check, WP01 T002/T009).

criteria.description: sk-progress--compact and sk-progress--narrow change only CSS layout; the label/progress/span triad, their attributes, and their document order are unchanged from the unmodified fixture.
criteria.notes: Verified by WP01 T007's layout-modifier structural-preservation assertion comparing Compact/Narrow against the unmodified Default (T10) fixture.

criteria.description: Completion is legible without relying on hue alone: the track/fill are distinguishable by boundary/shape, and the meta text is a second, non-colour channel.
criteria.notes: No colour-blindness simulation exists in this repo's harness. Visually reviewed against the rendered story (track border independent of fill colour, sk-progress__meta text present). Partial automated coverage: WP01 T008's forced-colors distinguishability assertion is the closest mechanical check, since it forces the same failure mode (colour-only signalling) to be visible under an achromatic rendering.

criteria.description: Under forced-colors: active, the track's boundary and the fill are each still distinguishable from the page background and from each other.
criteria.notes: Verified by WP01 T008's forced-colors emulation assertion (computed border/fill colour comparison) plus the CI-authoritative visual baseline (T008/T010).

criteria.description: Any transition authored on the fill is disabled under prefers-reduced-motion: reduce, scoped to exactly that selector and property; if no transition is authored, this is satisfied vacuously.
criteria.notes: Verified by WP01 T008's conditional static-source assertion over sk-progress.css (scoped guard present, or no transition exists to guard).

criteria.description: The component's default (dark) presentation and a LightMode story (class="sk-light") both exist and are driven by tokens, with LightMode rendering genuinely different computed styling.
criteria.notes: Verified by WP01 T005's computed-style-difference assertion between Default and LightMode, plus T009's axe gate over both themes and check-story-theme-wrapper.mjs's class="sk-light" check.

criteria.description: sk-progress ships only as packages/styles/src/progress/sk-progress.css plus authored .html fixtures with a generated barrel; no packages/elements/src/progress/, no custom element, no ::part(), and no manifest/React/Vue wrapper entry exists.
criteria.notes: Verified by WP01 T002's git ls-files packages/elements/src check and T009's ratchet-file diff checks (expected-parts.json, expected-docs.json, behaviours.json, mutations.json all unchanged).

criteria.description: packages/styles/src/index.ts exports the new component's barrel and packages/styles/package.json carries a ./progress/* subpath export.
criteria.notes: Verified by WP01 T002's edits plus T009's node scripts/check-release-graph.mjs gate run.

criteria.description: Documentation states the native three-part structure, that the consumer owns all arithmetic and text, and the exact set of supported determinate states and arrangements.
criteria.notes: Confirmed by reading WP01 T006's addition to docs/design-system/using-components.md against FR-014's required content list.

negative_invariants.description: No sk-progress custom element, no packages/elements/src/progress/ directory, no ::part(), and no behaviour or mutation registry entry for this component.
negative_invariants.verification_command: test ! -d packages/elements/src/progress && git diff --exit-code -- expected-parts.json expected-docs.json behaviours.json mutations.json

negative_invariants.description: No CSS content/counter()-based arithmetic, no JavaScript of any kind, no application state, and no timer updates a value anywhere in this component's source.
No indeterminate/loading state, stepper, task data, completion animation, or status-tone colour coding.
No new --sk-* token category is introduced absent a demonstrated gap and recorded maintainer sign-off.
apps/demo/dashboard-demo.html's existing .dash-progress-* rules and markup are not modified by this mission.
The required LightMode story wraps its fixture in class="sk-light", never data-theme="light".
This mission's markup and CSS are self-contained and do not compose with or reference any other #208 child component.
